** Temporary boosts or the Assist System can be used to make masterwork magic armour. It is not required to boost throughout the entire process, only for earlier steps: 
*** Crafting masterwork thread at a spinning wheel - entire crafting process
*** Crafting masterwork green, blue, and white cloth at the loom - entire crafting process
*** Designing the unfinished masterwork magic draft of the item at the pattern table
**** Once the unfinished masterwork magic draft has been created, it can be worked on without boosts at both the drafting table and the tailor's dummy, though if the level requirement is not met, progress is halved (gaining 10 progress at a time instead of 20)
***** The Assist System cannot be used to bypass the skill requirement and gain normal progress
***** Successfully avoiding a miscut still grants normal progress regardless of skill level
***** Repairing a damaged unfinished armour at the repairs table during the tailor's dummy process has no level requirement
